fields.summary: The Board adopts the Measure N Commission's recommendation to fund Aspire Lionel Wilson College Preparatory Academy for the 2022-23 school year, up to $570,425. Measure N pays for college and career readiness programs. The school is in its fifth year of probationary status under the program, with full implementation funding. The attached memo splits the amount into $218,450 ($850 for each of 257 pupils) plus $351,975 held in a probationary reserve fund.

21-2888.sourceIssue: The text gives $850.00 x 257 pupils, which equals $218,450, but states an amount not to exceed $570,425.00; the attached funding memo shows the $570,425.00 also includes $351,975.00 held in a probationary reserve fund.

fields.summary: The Board adopts the Measure N Commission's recommendation to fund Ralph J. Bunche Academy for the 2022-23 school year, up to $103,427.16. Measure N pays for college and career readiness programs. The school is in its second year of probationary status under the program, with full funding. The attached memo lists $103,427.16 as the allocation; it is not simply $850 x 77 pupils, since the memo says Alternative Education schools are funded on prior-year attendance.

21-2891.sourceIssue: The text gives $850.00 x 77 pupils, which equals $65,450, but states an amount not to exceed $103,427.16; the attached funding memo lists $103,427.16 as the allocation and says Alternative Education schools are funded on prior-year attendance, but does not show the calculation.
